10.1186/s13000-022-01222-7.interpretation: Molecularly confirmed EWSR1-NR4A3 cellular EMC with CD117 staining and a reported KIT exon-13 A-to-G variant. Surgery only, with approximately ten months without recurrence; no KIT-inhibitor treatment or functional drug-sensitivity experiment. The report does not supply an explicit HGVS protein change in its text. This cannot be pooled with the KIT W557G imatinib case or D579del sunitinib case as another treatment response. KIT-directed therapy was already proposed by the authors.

10.1111/1759-7714.14613.interpretation: One pleural-metastatic EMC case with NR4A3/EWSR1 fusion, TMB 4 mutations/Mb, absent PD-L1, abundant CD163-positive macrophages and sparse T cells. TGF-beta1/VEGF staining supports a microenvironment hypothesis, not demonstrated cytokine secretion, immune suppression or drug sensitivity. Anthracycline treatment reportedly stabilized disease; duration unspecified. TGF-beta/VEGF combinations were already proposed by the authors. Its absent FOXP3 staining differs from selected specimens in the 2026 biomarker study; cross-study tissue and assay differences prevent assuming a uniform EMC immune state.

10.1158/1078-0432.ccr-21-2480.interpretation: Three EMC patients enrolled in a mixed-sarcoma cabozantinib trial; one confirmed partial response. That patient first responded after ten cycles and remained on treatment at 99 cycles (28-day cycles), so 99 cycles is not response duration. Supplement S1 identifies no prior VEGF-targeting therapy for this responder. The overall trial did not meet its prespecified efficacy thresholds. Circulating biomarkers did not predict response, and no EMC-specific molecular predictor was established. This is a small clinical signal, not proof of general efficacy or benefit after pazopanib failure.

limits: Single cases and three-patient subgroup are not combined efficacy estimates. No new treatment demonstrated. Original assets with hashes retained in asset-retrieval-ledger.json.

additional_source_discrepancies.KIT2022: Case narrative says no necrosis; Discussion describes local necrosis. Exon-level mutation description cannot substitute for verified HGVS annotation.
additional_source_discrepancies.pleura2022: Main paragraph swaps the cytokine panel lettering relative to Figure4 caption; both stains are positive, but panel identity should follow the caption pending reconciliation. TMB described as absent in abstract but quantified as4/Mb in case text.
additional_source_discrepancies.cabozantinib2022: Grade3 hypertension/neutropenia percentages are inconsistent across abstract/body/table. Table3 counts9/54 hypertension and4/54 neutropenia; no EMC-specific toxicity rate inferred.
